    • designPressure

      public PidSafetyStudies.Policy designPressure(double fraction, double minimumMarginBar)
      Sets the design pressure rule: the larger of operating gauge pressure times (1 + fraction) and operating plus a minimum margin.
      Parameters:
      fraction - relative margin, for example 0.10
      minimumMarginBar - minimum absolute margin in bar
      Returns:
      this policy

    • flareBackPressure

      public PidSafetyStudies.Policy flareBackPressure(double bara)
      Sets the flare system back pressure seen by relief and blowdown devices.
      Parameters:
      bara - back pressure in bara
      Returns:
      this policy

    • segmentVolume

      public PidSafetyStudies.Policy segmentVolume(String equipmentTag, double volumeM3)
      Declares the gas volume of a segment without vessel geometry in the model, such as a compressor casing and its piping, so its blowdown can be sized.
      Parameters:
      equipmentTag - equipment owning the blowdown valve
      volumeM3 - segment volume in m3
      Returns:
      this policy

    • reliability

      public PidSafetyStudies.Policy reliability(double sensorRate, double logicRate, double finalElementRate, double proofTestHours)
      Sets the screening reliability data for the safety integrity calculation.
      Parameters:
      sensorRate - sensor dangerous failure rate per hour
      logicRate - logic solver dangerous failure rate per hour
      finalElementRate - final element (valve, actuator, solenoid) dangerous failure rate per hour
      proofTestHours - proof test interval in hours
      Returns:
      this policy
